# origincloud_billing_billing_account (Resource)

An organization's billing account: who invoices are issued to, and how its projects' usage is paid.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) The name the console and spend-limit alerts show. Not empty. An organization's default account is called `default` until it is renamed.
- `organization` (String) The organization the billing account is in. Changing it replaces the billing account.

### Optional

- `billing_address` (Attributes) The postal address invoices are issued to. Required to create an account; unset only on an organization's default account until its profile is set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--billing_address))
- `contact_person` (String) Who invoices are addressed to. Required to create an account; empty only on an organization's default account until its profile is set.
- `invoice_email` (String) Where invoices are sent. Required to create an account; empty only on an organization's default account until its profile is set.
- `vat_id` (String) The VAT identification number invoices name; empty for none. Required for a billing address outside Germany.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) When the billing account was created. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `creator` (String) The principal that created the billing account, such as `user:<id>` or `service_account:<id>`.
- `default_account` (Boolean) Whether this is the organization's default billing account: the one its new projects are linked to. Every organization has exactly one, and it can't be deleted.
- `id` (String) The billing account's resource name, the same as `name`.
- `name` (String) The billing account's resource name.
- `payment_method` (Attributes) How the account is paid. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--payment_method))
- `urn` (String) The billing account's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use.

<a id="nestedatt--billing_address"></a>
### Nested Schema for `billing_address`

Required:

- `city` (String) The city.
- `postal_code` (String) The postal code.
- `region_code` (String) The country, as the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of one of the countries ListBillingCountries lists, such as `DE`.
- `street` (String) The street and house number.


<a id="nestedatt--payment_method"></a>
### Nested Schema for `payment_method`

Read-Only:

- `card_brand` (String) The verified card's brand, such as `visa`; empty while no payment method is verified, and for one that isn't a card.
- `card_last4` (String) The verified card's last four digits; empty while no payment method is verified, and for one that isn't a card.
- `state` (String) Whether the account can pay for usage. One of `MISSING`, `VERIFIED`, `NOT_REQUIRED`.
